metadata.title: Fiber Optic Cable Supplier & Telecom Solutions | Vocom
metadata.description: Vocom supplies bulk outdoor, ADSS and FTTH drop fiber optic cable to US network builders, plus cross-Pacific connectivity. Request a quote.

attributes.text: Vocom Wholesale Fiber Optic Cable for Telecom & Data Centers

Vocom supplies all types of fiber optic cable, build-to-order and shipped worldwide. Standard lead time 6 to 8 weeks, up to 10 weeks for high-count or custom builds, with 2 to 3 week expedited air freight available.
Working with renowned, trusted, and leading enterprises
Two Ways to Get Your Fiber
Choose the timeline that fits your build.
Build-to-order from tier 1 manufacturers, our standard timeline for most fiber optic cable orders. High-count or custom builds may take up to 10 weeks.
Best for: planned, forecastable demand. Build-to-order, with delivery staged to your build phases.
Need it faster? Air-shipped expedited service delivers your fiber optic cable in 2 to 3 weeks.
Best for: fixed deployment dates you can’t miss. Made-to-order, built to your spec.
Bulk & Wholesale Fiber Optic Cable for Telecom, Data Centers and Infrastructure

Vocom supplies bulk single-mode fiber optic cable to telecom networks, data centers and critical infrastructure across the USA, North America and 100+ regions worldwide. Every cable is sourced from tier 1 manufacturers using Fujikura fiber glass, built to order and quality-checked per shipment, from a carrier founded in 1998.
GYTA/GYTS constructions for duct, aerial and direct-burial deployment.
High-density ribbon for data center and backbone builds.
Proven designs for access and metro networks.
G.652D and OM3/OM4 options in bulk lengths.
Your fiber count, length, jacket and print, built to order.
GCYFTY and GYFS loose-tube cable, supplied build-to-order from 12F to 864F for outside plant routes.

children.name: Ribbon and high fiber count cable

attributes.text: Ribbon and high fiber count cable
Rollable and flat ribbon from 12F to 6912F, including 1728F dielectric, for duct-limited and hyperscale routes.

children.name: Air blown micro cable and microduct

attributes.text: Air blown micro cable and microduct
Micro cable, HDPE microduct bundles and composite vaults, specified together and delivered in 6 to 8 weeks standard, up to 10 weeks for custom builds.

children.name: ADSS, aerial and direct burial cable

attributes.text: ADSS, aerial and direct burial cable
All-dielectric self-supporting cable for long pole spans, figure 8, and armored cable for trenched routes, to 432F.
Flat and armored drop in G.657A1, with OptiTap compatible IP68 field connectors and terminal boxes.
Factory-terminated MPO and MTP trunks, cassettes and indoor rollable ribbon to 864F, staged to your build phases.
Every cable, duct, vault and connector we supply, with codes, fiber counts and construction in one list.

attributes.altText: Bulk single-mode fibre cable North America and outdoor fibre optic cable supply

attributes.text: Where the fiber supply story becomes visible
Trusted by North American Network Builders
From open-access FTTH to municipal broadband, operators across the US and Canada source their outdoor and drop cable through Vocom: specified, build-to-order, and delivered to site.
Open-access fiber operator · California, Colorado & Minnesota
GCYFTY-144 loose-tube and toneable flat-drop cable, supplied build-to-order for multi-state open-access FTTH builds.
Pre-connectorised G657A1 single-fiber drops in 100 to 600ft lengths, plus GCYFTY-144/432 loose-tube and SCA field connectors.
GCYXTY-24 loose-tube cable sourced for a city-owned fiber network rollout.
From Specification to Shipment in Four Steps

attributes.altText: Outdoor loose-tube fibre cable, ADSS aerial cable and FTTH drop cable supply

attributes.text: Cable type, fiber count, length, destination and timeline.
Pricing and production schedule, typically within 48 hours.
Produced by tier 1 partners, quality-checked per order.
International shipping with full import/export support.

From specification to shipment, every stage of the sourcing process is managed with precision, from technical requirements and tier 1 partner production to quality control, documentation, and final delivery.
Cross-Pacific Connectivity for Carriers and Enterprises
Beyond the cable itself, Vocom operates as a full telecommunications provider: private capacity, internet transit and voice across the Pacific.
Dedicated private circuits between APAC and the US.
Last-mile access and wholesale voice/IDD minutes.
Vocom AI: Intelligence Layered on Your Network
AI agents for customer service, real-time analytics, threat detection and predictive network maintenance,  built by a team that has run telecom infrastructure since 1998.
documentation, customs and logistics on us.
a supplier that also operates networks.
Do you supply fiber optic cable internationally?
Yes, we export worldwide with full import/export documentation support, serving projects across 100+ regions.
What is the minimum order for bulk fiber cable?
Orders are quoted by cable type, fiber count and length. Contact us with your specification for volume pricing.
What is the typical lead time?
6 to 8 weeks standard (up to 10 weeks for high-count or custom builds), or 2 to 3 weeks with expedited air freight, confirmed at quote stage.
Do you provide datasheets and specifications?
Yes, technical datasheets are available for all constructions on request.
Do you also provide connectivity services?
Yes, IEPL/IPLC private circuits, IP transit, voice termination and data center services across the Pacific.
Send us your cable type, fiber count, length and destination, we’ll come back with a quote and production timeline.
